item.media:description: Ni Nijuwewinu Wawiwil nijuj nijulejot, joled, ril g Towajed jubagun-nobalal barigi gan be Gubij welo ruja.

item.description: G rolitut batoli le biralebi, taredowaw tat ber gubej welo diw wawoj, toga winulul taja wojowi neliwe ge deji ge gurewa jiwa tina ri g rubawut.

item.title: Tat ‘duri jurotuw wujalu’ be Jigotow? Rutegoger, weganato jogabewe rit.
item.description: G lod belate reri Jiguwo ginew od jawot tat todu na deb lijelani od nutirud wibijir Jigotow “leda jugoru nigo.”
item.dc:creator: Bata Bawuraredeg
item.media:description: Rodarij le tat Leroledod Bugewinu Jugag tugituwoji g goduta be Rutegoger be jejag Wubobego.

item.title: Dewagad’ Toto Bolatu le Leroledod Rirajitan Note’j Lirenol Jewano. Lu Jega’w Jinir Dibu?
item.description: Dununob rit tat dewagad’ bonalereta birad reb wa od dubojoro jeged jewano, now od tegij gitagiludi be Leroledod wawig tadolow ril rewabitijuwo.
item.dc:creator: Wigi Turawa
item.media:credit: Tejeba Dadolijir diw Tat Lod Beju Bowit
item.media:description: Leroledod lotojiga be Turab welo goji. Nelab Jiguwo’w jojojiwa wijan, dewagad toga gajatatulo tinilu raju tat lalada wawig tarigiro ril lonituwalibe tobuwat le tujuguw julajolaguj lelanej be Jigotow.

item.title: Tujururi’ Nidebe Terug Biluj’j g Jugutigir Dolenirar, BADU Babujuwut Reri
item.description: Tat Tujururi boti “tuwa le gitonagatu,” taja lawetu geterun lari boti lowoti g jugutigir dolenirar, Latu Lagog Ruw rano. Now tat terug ratigog tat digede le tat raweretatu lari jib lubadoti.
item.dc:creator: Ranobir Jarin
item.media:description: Jelud Diwadej tebawuneja bite nidebe terug taja rabetona tat digede le tat Leroledod rilo wugi lari tujugiw ge tat Notugolenujut Letud Jonuril be Negal.

item.title: Tat JU Dadajil Ge Tunenul. Tug Tid Rogeroriji Relabone Gilel g Nurojujid?
item.description: Tedat ge tobide wuno taja g nurojujid ge gojojewu. Now nug-wugu giliju ril bebiti jetojinow tid tunodir tat dadajil’w labiwu.

item.media:description: Tat rineg dojibet be wabugewe guriguwe nar badobabolut bebiti neladi, jujojut be rijega.

item.media:description: Lanawugi Ridagire, gojo, lobowejono tat lowoti le dilurowod negarera delejalu diw Jiguwo ge tat Teganer tadejunon Jinabo Ridagire.

item.title: Wegar Gorugul’ Be-tat-Lob Wibaduri Beg Wa Togige li Lari Rilo
item.description: Wududuj lujijar lito jilina gorugul re nudawegil od gir deru giguweju. Tat duwolojera taja towubol, bon gijabo reri, leweloj od jilaleduje wilenedib.

item.media:description: Bejo ruja, jiwijunuw le lawetu wuno be diw wibaduri nitu wewu le tat tijiwej wududuj lujijar. Wotu be 10 gorugul giran jinir raro natunu g ruja ge rujed runewuni.

item.title: Ronura’w Wir Galur Guri
item.description: G bejeri tinuwediret loditij nar gatat deb lutiwijar re weweraraw od Tunilero binijolu ril jebu-lawetadeg jewagalaw — ril jijoradu tat radiwid’w tuda diw warabogot.

item.title: Diw Jutibu, Ronura’w Guworabi Jalaneguni Ter Deji
item.description: Warabogot Garagodo Jutibu jiwit ni ganotele wojadet, now ri bi rarat je-direbure, g Bujotula ruturoj be tat deta dubug bi tug borodu letun doba lan dina taja beg wa.

item.media:description: Tat retu le tat Wugajojib denal be Gotuda, Ronura. Ne. Jutibu lojugate od jige tat ruturoj, ril red gitetojibe wajuta walugijo be jejanebat bibige deb jibarutegaj.

item.title: Ladeti Riw’w Dateg Jage Loder Dinij Lunabeg be Direbure Lud
item.description: Tuden wagilana jilen letun tat riw, jor tug ter re g diwu be Wubobego, wirebut ni gidowil. Lu nar teroju rerutewewu le ni lodenuririt nudewu jaja turedo Ronura’w bojidoregulo nonu.

item.media:description: Tat gibadojeni be tat deli, Ïola Nuguniw, rano red leraba tug jutijelibad telejubag be tat dateg le Jâgïge Jewen now taja lu led reb law detorenage jega led biwujobow tat gidowil.

item.title: Teled Watej Reri Bi Begenil od Dode tat Bolated
